name: FinaleArena
source: TASK-0007 ring-out finale arena (Rg1). Arena-local coordinates: deck top at y=0. In game the arena is placed with its deck top at world y=60 over the Finale zone (MatchConfig.Zones.Finale X/Z), so the ring-out height y=-20 here is world y=40.
note: Flat floating deck plus four low step-up bumps. Ki Burst knockback (and Echo bursts) push rivals off the open edge. Stock R15 movement; Dash is horizontal only, so a player below the deck top cannot get back.
ground_is_parts: a floating finale deck over open void; falling below it is the elimination
open_edges: ring-out arena: the open edge is the whole point, there is no wall

parts.note: 2 studs = one auto-step, so it never blocks movement; it only breaks up straight-line pushes

ringOut.note: Knocked off = eliminated (TASK-0007 AC1). Recovery is only possible while still above the deck top (the knockback's upward arc), which the server does not need to model.

sightlines.note: open arena by design; every rival should be visible
